quotes.text: You don't have to be big to be brave.
Today is a good day to be gentle with yourself.
Every ordinary thing is a little bit magic if you look closely.
You've made it through every hard day so far.
Kindness counts, even the quiet kind.
There's room for you to rest.
Being here is enough for now.
You're allowed to start again, any time.

jokes.text: Why did the egg refuse to tell a joke? It didn't want to crack up.
What do you call a sleepy dinosaur? A dino-snore.
Why did the pebble feel calm? It was a little boulder now.
What do clouds wear under their raincoats? Thunderwear.
How do you cheer up a tiny star? You give it a little space.
What did the ocean say to the shore? Nothing — it just waved.
What do you call a bear with no teeth? A gummy bear.
Why did the banana go to the party? Because it was a-peeling.
What's a ghost's favorite dessert? I-scream.
Why did the leaf go to the doctor? It was feeling a little green.
What kind of tree fits in your hand? A palm tree.
Why don't eggs like fast jokes? They can't handle the yolk pressure.

dares.text: Text someone you miss — just to say hi.
Find one thing nearby that's a nice color.
Give someone (or something) a compliment today.
Look out a window for ten whole seconds.
Write down one good thing about today.
Stretch your arms way up high.
Do the tiny task you've been putting off — just start it.
Say thank you to someone before the day ends.
